label: Dramatic lighting
description: Stylised colour, contrast and shadow effects for cinematic images.
notes: Designed colour relationships, silhouettes and expressive light patterns belong here. Studio owns named photographic rigs and modifiers; indoor_practical owns ordinary in-scene fixtures; natural owns literal sun, sky and moon sources. Colour treatments can be used across depicted eras.
